description: An attendance record is a component of the event it records; without the event the attendance assertion has no meaning.
An attendance record is a component of the member it records; without the member the attendance assertion has no meaning.
A budget line is a component of the event it funds; an event is composed of one or more category-level budget lines.
An expense is a component charged against the budget line that funds it; every expense carries a budget link.
An expense belongs to the member who submitted it; every expense record carries a member link, so removing the member would strip the expense of its attribution.

connection_condition: income.link_to_member corresponds to member.member_id where present; the link is absent for receipts that do not come from a member
description: An income receipt may be attributed to a member, but non-member funding sources produce receipts with no member association, so the connection is optional rather than compositional.

connection_condition: member.link_to_major corresponds to major.major_id where present
description: A member declares a major, which places the member in an academic programme and its college; the declaration is optional, so the connection is not compositional.
A member's zip code resolves to one postal reference record, which supplies the member's city and state. The postal table is a national reference set, not a club-owned entity.

connection_condition: the member's position value is not Inactive
description: An active member is a member; the category's value domain is a subset of the roster, distinguished purely by the recorded position.

connection_condition: the receipt's source value is Dues
description: Dues income is a kind of income source; the category's value domain is a subset of the source values.

connection_condition: the derived value aggregates the costs of the expenses charged to the same budget line
description: The spent amount of a budget line is the accumulated cost of the expenses charged against that line.

connection_condition: the remaining value is formed from the allocated amount less the spent amount of the same budget line
description: The remaining amount of a budget line is its allocation not yet consumed; it turns negative when the line is overspent.

connection_condition: total income is reduced by the total expense cost recorded over the same period
description: The club's net financial balance is computed from total income and total expense rather than stored anywhere in the database.

connection_condition: the spent amount is expressed relative to the allocated amount of the same budget line
description: Budget utilization is computed from the spent and allocated amounts of each budget line.
